purpose: Carry an already resolved, subject-bound, approved and currently authorized semantic specification into runtime execution context without giving the runtime authority to resolve, approve, authorize, or plan semantics.

requires: AuthorizationSnapshot matching the exact subject-bound approval
native_projection.interpretation_policy: EffectiveSpec fields are transported as opaque semantic facts with provenance; the bridge never chooses AgentLayerSpec constructors or graph topology.

runtime_binding.identity_policy: No bridge-generated authoritative runtime_subject_id. Existing intent, approval, subject identity, and authorization policy tuple is carried verbatim.
runtime_binding.wasm_validation_scope: shape/syntax/bounds of the supplied tuple only; WASM does not re-run Resolution or AuthorizationPolicy

receipt_binding.policy: Verifier receipts may carry the current workspace runtime-subject tuple as execution context.
receipt_binding.meaning: The verifier proves the numerical comparison under the supplied bound execution context; it does not independently prove that Resolution or AuthorizationPolicy was legitimate.
receipt_binding.unbound: Legacy/unbridged runtime execution remains representable as runtime_subject.status=unbound.

invariants: bridge does not select layers or graph topology
bridge does not create approval or authorization
bridge does not create a replacement semantic identity
runtime binding is control metadata and does not mutate LayerRegistry
runtime binding participates in AgentWorkspace.snapshot so no-mutation checks can observe it
unknown semantic fields remain opaque rather than guessed
deferred: automatic runtime fault to ResolutionDiagnostic conversion
